Package dev.opencollab.paletter.item.component

Class RenderOffsets

java.lang.Object
dev.opencollab.paletter.item.component.RenderOffsets
All Implemented Interfaces:
ItemComponent, WireOnlyItemComponent
@Deprecated public final class RenderOffsets extends Object implements WireOnlyItemComponent
Deprecated.
retired from the add-on format, still sent for legacy content; will be removed if clients stop honouring it
minecraft:render_offsets: where the item is drawn in each hand, per view.

Retired from the add-on format (the Bedrock Dedicated Server of Bedrock 26.60 rejects it at every format_version). Paletter assumes current clients still honour it on the wire and keeps sending it for legacy content; it will be removed if clients stop honouring it. A RenderOffsets.Preset is the legacy form Geyser sends for armor converted from v1 custom mappings: a bare string render_offsets (no minecraft: prefix, not a component) that names the client's built-in offsets of an armor piece. It is written next to the hands (if any); with only a preset, minecraft:render_offsets is not sent.

Since:
1.0.0
